purpose: Recover the already materialized, score-blind N8 candidate without any optimizer/model retry; prove predictions exactly from frozen features/preprocessing/coefficients, create typed provenance and family freeze, then run the unchanged S17-N3 comparison.

materialization_gate.R1: All eleven input hashes and N8 PARTIAL_PRE_SCORE status match.
materialization_gate.R2: For each Q3/Q4 fold, frozen preprocessing applied to frozen features and frozen coefficients reproduces every selected_action and COST5_SPO_PLUS value exactly (max abs <=1e-12).
materialization_gate.R3: Recomputed finite SPO+ final objective is <= zero-init objective+1e-12 on the original active training rows; coefficients/gradient finite.
materialization_gate.R4: Fit/selection label maxima are taken from S17-N3 splits and strictly precede shifted bases; champion provenance hashes match N7.
materialization_gate.R5: Provenance timestamps are uniformly serialized datetimes; family manifest is hashed before any assessment metric call.
materialization_gate.failure_action: Stop pre-score and close non-score with pre_score_gate_failed; never refit or mutate the frozen prediction vector.

two_phase.materialize: write a byte-copy of frozen predictions, typed provenance, optimizer verification, family manifest; assessment score calls=0
two_phase.evaluate: new process accepts exact family SHA, verifies every output hash, calls S17-N3 and two outer point scores; predictions never change

evaluation.promotion: candidate point delta >=0.001635; stable promotion_eligible on blocks 3/7/14; Q3 and Q4 deltas positive; exact/additive sign agree; candidate in MCS and incumbent excluded.

pass_label: SUPPORTED_RETROSPECTIVE only under unchanged N8 promotion gate; otherwise score-bearing REFUTED/INCONCLUSIVE
